Hello fellow pet owners,

I’d like to express my gratitude and love to this veterinarian clinic that have nurtured and helped my Rottweiler puppy named Rufus. Veterinarian Griffintown clinic has the most professional, attentive and respectful towards their clients and house pet patients.

I never owned a dog before and since now that I now own one Rufus is family to me and a childhood dream come true. The clinic is close to my neighborhood which is a huge plus because I’m a hometown Montrealer that grew up downtown. Let me also say that when my pup was ill with an infection the staff over the clinic was very attentive, gave love and reassurance to my puppy as if it was their own. I find that the pricing is very fair and taking care of your furry bundle of joy is priceless and shouldn’t be up for a debate.

With Veterinarian Griffintown you are at the right place for any circumstances or emergencies.

You’ll thank me later.

Peace love and light to all.

Kind regards.
